title: Exterior look and visual appeal
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly discuss the G60's appearance, with many praising its overall look while many other fragments use the word "look" in unrelated or ambiguous ways.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's exterior styling as great, fantastic, pleasing, and lovable to look at.

negative.summary: The negative review links needing to look away from the road to a perceived safety concern rather than criticizing the vehicle's exterior appearance.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are dominated by ambiguous uses of the word "look" or incomplete context, so they do not clearly express sentiment about the vehicle's appearance.

limitations: Many sampled fragments contain the word "look" without clearly referring to vehicle styling, which makes this topic partly lexically noisy.
Undetermined fragments include at least one statement that sounds positive in isolation, but the assigned sentiment is undetermined and cannot be reclassified from the sample alone.
The sampled examples are limited, so finer distinctions such as specific design elements are not sufficiently evidenced.
